schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) - { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: A4 (Content Factory wave 17)

entries.vietlish: eat medicine after lunch
entries.natural: take medicine after lunch
entries.sourcePattern: uống thuốc -> eat/drink medicine; English collocates take + medicine
entries.context: My grandmother reminds me to eat medicine after lunch every day.

entries.vietlish: drink two pills before sleeping
entries.natural: take two pills before going to sleep
entries.sourcePattern: uống thuốc viên -> drink pills; English uses take pills
entries.context: The nurse told him to drink two pills before sleeping.

entries.vietlish: join a medical checkup next week
entries.natural: have a medical checkup next week
entries.sourcePattern: đi khám sức khỏe -> join checkup; English uses have/go for a checkup
entries.context: Our company asks all employees to join a medical checkup next week.

entries.vietlish: open a health insurance package
entries.natural: buy a health insurance plan
entries.sourcePattern: mở gói bảo hiểm -> open package; English uses buy/get a plan
entries.context: My parents want to open a health insurance package before they retire.

entries.vietlish: make an appointment with the dentist
entries.natural: book an appointment with the dentist
entries.sourcePattern: đặt lịch hẹn -> make is possible, but book/schedule is the target service collocation
entries.context: I need to make an appointment with the dentist for a toothache.

entries.vietlish: take a blood pressure for my father
entries.natural: check my father’s blood pressure
entries.sourcePattern: đo huyết áp -> take a pressure; English uses check/take someone’s blood pressure
entries.context: The pharmacist helped take a blood pressure for my father.

entries.vietlish: catch a taxi through the app
entries.natural: book a taxi through the app
entries.sourcePattern: bắt xe -> catch a taxi; app context uses book/order a ride
entries.context: It was raining, so I tried to catch a taxi through the app.

entries.vietlish: take a motorbike taxi on the phone
entries.natural: book a motorbike taxi on my phone
entries.sourcePattern: đặt xe ôm -> take/book distinction; phone app context uses book
entries.context: I usually take a motorbike taxi on the phone when I leave work late.

entries.vietlish: run the deadline for the report
entries.natural: meet the deadline for the report
entries.sourcePattern: chạy deadline -> run deadline; English collocates meet a deadline
entries.context: The team worked overtime to run the deadline for the report.

entries.vietlish: do overtime until midnight
entries.natural: work overtime until midnight
entries.sourcePattern: làm tăng ca -> do overtime; English collocates work overtime
entries.context: Because of the launch, we had to do overtime until midnight.

entries.vietlish: make a contract with the supplier
entries.natural: sign a contract with the supplier
entries.sourcePattern: làm hợp đồng -> make contract; English often uses sign/draw up depending on role
entries.context: The manager will make a contract with the supplier tomorrow.

entries.vietlish: solve a customer complaint carefully
entries.natural: handle a customer complaint carefully
entries.sourcePattern: giải quyết khiếu nại -> solve complaint; English service collocation uses handle/address
entries.context: The support team must solve a customer complaint carefully.

entries.vietlish: receive a salary at the end of month
entries.natural: get paid at the end of the month
entries.sourcePattern: nhận lương -> receive salary; natural workplace English uses get paid
entries.context: Most workers receive a salary at the end of month.

entries.vietlish: increase my English level quickly
entries.natural: improve my English quickly
entries.sourcePattern: tăng trình độ tiếng Anh -> increase level; English uses improve English
entries.context: I joined this course to increase my English level quickly.

entries.vietlish: study vocabulary by heart every night
entries.natural: memorize vocabulary every night
entries.sourcePattern: học thuộc lòng -> study by heart; English uses memorize/learn by heart
entries.context: My cousin tries to study vocabulary by heart every night before the test.

entries.vietlish: give homework to the teacher late
entries.natural: turn in homework to the teacher late
entries.sourcePattern: nộp bài -> give homework; English collocates turn in/submit homework
entries.context: I forgot to give homework to the teacher late last Friday.

entries.vietlish: write a test in the classroom
entries.natural: take a test in the classroom
entries.sourcePattern: làm bài kiểm tra -> write a test in learner English; US English uses take a test
entries.context: The students will write a test in the classroom after lunch.

entries.vietlish: learn a driving license course
entries.natural: take a driving course
entries.sourcePattern: học bằng lái -> learn license course; English says take a driving course
entries.context: My brother plans to learn a driving license course this summer.

entries.vietlish: open a saving account for my child
entries.natural: open a savings account for my child
entries.sourcePattern: tài khoản tiết kiệm -> saving account singular; English banking term is savings account
entries.context: We want to open a saving account for my child.

entries.vietlish: make a transfer money to my landlord
entries.natural: transfer money to my landlord
entries.sourcePattern: chuyển khoản -> make a transfer money; English uses transfer money/make a transfer
entries.context: I need to make a transfer money to my landlord today.

entries.vietlish: take cash from the ATM
entries.natural: withdraw cash from the ATM
entries.sourcePattern: rút tiền -> take cash; English banking collocation is withdraw cash
entries.context: She stopped to take cash from the ATM before shopping.

entries.vietlish: pay the electricity money online
entries.natural: pay the electricity bill online
entries.sourcePattern: tiền điện -> electricity money; English uses electricity bill
entries.context: My father learned how to pay the electricity money online.

entries.vietlish: cut the internet service this month
entries.natural: cancel the internet service this month
entries.sourcePattern: cắt mạng -> cut service; English customer action is cancel service
entries.context: We moved house, so we need to cut the internet service this month.

entries.vietlish: repair the leak pipe in the kitchen
entries.natural: fix the leaking pipe in the kitchen
entries.sourcePattern: sửa ống nước bị rò -> repair leak pipe; English uses leaking pipe
entries.context: The landlord promised to repair the leak pipe in the kitchen.

entries.vietlish: cook rice with the rice cooker
entries.natural: make rice in the rice cooker
entries.sourcePattern: nấu cơm -> cook rice; natural household English often says make rice
entries.context: Can you cook rice with the rice cooker before dinner?

entries.vietlish: drink soup before the main dish
entries.natural: have soup before the main dish
entries.sourcePattern: uống canh -> drink soup; English collocates have/eat soup
entries.context: In my family we usually drink soup before the main dish.

entries.vietlish: call a dish at the restaurant
entries.natural: order a dish at the restaurant
entries.sourcePattern: gọi món -> call a dish; English uses order a dish
entries.context: I did not know what to call a dish at the restaurant.

entries.vietlish: calculate the bill separately
entries.natural: split the bill separately
entries.sourcePattern: tính tiền riêng -> calculate bill; English says split the bill/pay separately
entries.context: After dinner we decided to calculate the bill separately.

entries.vietlish: make a reservation table for six
entries.natural: reserve a table for six
entries.sourcePattern: đặt bàn -> make reservation table; English uses reserve/book a table
entries.context: Could you help me make a reservation table for six?

entries.vietlish: take a haircut after work
entries.natural: get a haircut after work
entries.sourcePattern: đi cắt tóc -> take haircut; English collocates get a haircut
entries.context: I will take a haircut after work because my hair is too long.

entries.vietlish: wash the photo for my passport
entries.natural: print the photo for my passport
entries.sourcePattern: rửa ảnh -> wash photo; English uses print/develop photos
entries.context: The shop can wash the photo for my passport in ten minutes.

entries.vietlish: make exercise at the gym
entries.natural: work out at the gym
entries.sourcePattern: tập thể dục -> make exercise; English uses exercise/work out
entries.context: My sister likes to make exercise at the gym after work.

entries.vietlish: play yoga every morning
entries.natural: do yoga every morning
entries.sourcePattern: tập yoga -> play yoga; English collocates do yoga
entries.context: My aunt likes to play yoga every morning to relax.

entries.vietlish: run a meeting with clients
entries.natural: hold a meeting with clients
entries.sourcePattern: tổ chức họp -> run/hold distinction; English often uses hold a meeting
entries.context: The sales team will run a meeting with clients on Friday.

entries.vietlish: catch the meeting on Zoom
entries.natural: join the meeting on Zoom
entries.sourcePattern: vào họp -> catch/join; English uses join an online meeting
entries.context: I was late, so I had to catch the meeting on Zoom from the taxi.

entries.vietlish: send a feedback to the teacher
entries.natural: give feedback to the teacher
entries.sourcePattern: gửi phản hồi -> send feedback; English collocates give feedback
entries.context: Parents can send a feedback to the teacher after class.

entries.vietlish: take a complaint form at the counter
entries.natural: fill out a complaint form at the counter
entries.sourcePattern: lấy/điền đơn khiếu nại -> take form; target action is fill out
entries.context: The clerk asked me to take a complaint form at the counter.

entries.vietlish: open a new password for the account
entries.natural: create a new password for the account
entries.sourcePattern: tạo/mở mật khẩu -> open password; English uses create/set password
entries.context: The app asked me to open a new password for the account.

entries.vietlish: make a screenshot of the error
entries.natural: take a screenshot of the error
entries.sourcePattern: chụp màn hình -> make screenshot; English collocates take a screenshot
entries.context: Please make a screenshot of the error and send it to support.

entries.vietlish: close the notification on my phone
entries.natural: turn off the notification on my phone
entries.sourcePattern: tắt thông báo -> close notification; English uses turn off/disable notifications
entries.context: I want to close the notification on my phone during class.

entries.vietlish: I very remember my old teacher
entries.natural: I remember my old teacher very well
entries.sourcePattern: rất nhớ -> very remember; English modifies remember with very well/really
entries.context: When I see this photo, I very remember my old teacher.

entries.vietlish: I very miss Vietnamese food
entries.natural: I miss Vietnamese food a lot
entries.sourcePattern: rất nhớ -> very miss; English uses miss a lot/really miss
entries.context: After two months abroad, I very miss Vietnamese food.

entries.vietlish: my heart is not peaceful today
entries.natural: I do not feel at peace today
entries.sourcePattern: lòng không yên -> heart not peaceful; English expresses emotional state directly
entries.context: Because of the exam result, my heart is not peaceful today.

entries.vietlish: the company has many big people
entries.natural: the company has many important people
entries.sourcePattern: người lớn/nhân vật lớn -> big people; English uses important/senior people
entries.context: At the conference, the company has many big people in the room.

entries.vietlish: I go first and you come later
entries.natural: I will leave first, and you can come later
entries.sourcePattern: đi trước -> go first; English often uses leave first in departures
entries.context: I am busy, so I go first and you come later.

entries.vietlish: I come back my country next year
entries.natural: I will go back to my country next year
entries.sourcePattern: về nước -> come back country; English needs go back to/return to
entries.context: If I cannot find a job, I come back my country next year.

entries.vietlish: she has a hot temper blood
entries.natural: she has a hot temper
entries.sourcePattern: nóng máu -> hot blood; English idiom is hot temper
entries.context: Be careful when you criticize her because she has a hot temper blood.

entries.vietlish: do not make my face lose
entries.natural: do not make me lose face
entries.sourcePattern: mất mặt -> face lose; English idiom order is lose face
entries.context: Please do not make my face lose in front of my parents.

entries.vietlish: I heard the smell of smoke
entries.natural: I smelled smoke
entries.sourcePattern: nghe mùi -> hear smell in Vietnamese; English uses smell
entries.context: When I entered the kitchen, I heard the smell of smoke.

entries.vietlish: I see the movie very hay
entries.natural: I think the movie is very good
entries.sourcePattern: hay -> good/interesting; English does not borrow Vietnamese adjective hay
entries.context: Many friends told me that I see the movie very hay.

entries.vietlish: this job eats a lot of time
entries.natural: this job takes a lot of time
entries.sourcePattern: ăn thời gian -> eat time; English uses take time
entries.context: My brother says this job eats a lot of time during audit season.

entries.vietlish: the road is eating my tire
entries.natural: the road is wearing down my tire
entries.sourcePattern: ăn lốp -> eat tire; English uses wear down/damage
entries.context: The driver complained that the road is eating my tire every week.

entries.vietlish: the rain is big today
entries.natural: it is raining heavily today
entries.sourcePattern: mưa lớn -> big rain; English uses heavy rain/raining heavily
entries.context: Be careful on the highway because the rain is big today.

entries.vietlish: the sun is very harsh at noon
entries.natural: the sun is very strong at noon
entries.sourcePattern: nắng gắt -> harsh sun; natural English often says strong sun
entries.context: You should wear a hat because the sun is very harsh at noon.

entries.vietlish: the wind is strong until scary
entries.natural: the wind is frighteningly strong
entries.sourcePattern: mạnh đến sợ -> until scary; English uses so/frighteningly
entries.context: Last night the wind is strong until scary.

entries.vietlish: I am afraid lost documents
entries.natural: I am afraid of losing the documents
entries.sourcePattern: sợ mất giấy tờ -> afraid lost; English needs afraid of + gerund
entries.context: When traveling, I am afraid lost documents.

entries.vietlish: my phone is out of battery already
entries.natural: my phone has already run out of battery
entries.sourcePattern: hết pin rồi -> out of battery already; English needs has run out
entries.context: Sorry I could not call you because my phone is out of battery already.

entries.vietlish: the app is stuck network
entries.natural: the app is stuck because of the network
entries.sourcePattern: kẹt mạng -> stuck network; English needs preposition/cause phrase
entries.context: The app is stuck network, so I cannot upload the file.

entries.vietlish: the room is lack of air
entries.natural: the room does not have enough air circulation
entries.sourcePattern: thiếu không khí -> lack of air; English uses lacks air circulation/is stuffy
entries.context: Please open the window because the room is lack of air.

entries.vietlish: my eyes are flower when I stand up
entries.natural: I feel dizzy when I stand up
entries.sourcePattern: hoa mắt -> flower eyes; English says feel dizzy/see spots
entries.context: After sitting too long, my eyes are flower when I stand up.

entries.vietlish: he speaks until I headache
entries.natural: he talks so much that I get a headache
entries.sourcePattern: nói tới nhức đầu -> until headache; English uses so much that
entries.context: When my neighbor talks about politics, he speaks until I headache.

entries.vietlish: I work until forget eating
entries.natural: I work so much that I forget to eat
entries.sourcePattern: làm tới quên ăn -> until forget eating; English uses so...that
entries.context: When deadlines come, I work until forget eating.

entries.vietlish: this price is soft for students
entries.natural: this price is affordable for students
entries.sourcePattern: giá mềm -> soft price; English uses affordable/reasonable
entries.context: Compared with other courses, this price is soft for students.

entries.vietlish: the teacher is easy to students
entries.natural: the teacher is lenient with students
entries.sourcePattern: dễ với học sinh -> easy to; English uses lenient with
entries.context: Many students like that the teacher is easy to students.

entries.vietlish: the boss is difficult with small mistakes
entries.natural: the boss is strict about small mistakes
entries.sourcePattern: khó với lỗi nhỏ -> difficult with; English uses strict about
entries.context: The boss is difficult with small mistakes in reports.

entries.vietlish: my salary is thin this month
entries.natural: my salary is low this month
entries.sourcePattern: lương mỏng -> thin salary; English uses low/small salary
entries.context: Because I took unpaid leave, my salary is thin this month.

entries.vietlish: the class is crowded until no seat
entries.natural: the class is so crowded that there are no seats
entries.sourcePattern: đông tới không có ghế -> until no seat; English uses so...that
entries.context: The class is crowded until no seat on Monday mornings.

entries.vietlish: I am heavy head after the flight
entries.natural: my head feels heavy after the flight
entries.sourcePattern: nặng đầu -> heavy head; English uses head feels heavy
entries.context: Because I slept badly, I am heavy head after the flight.

entries.vietlish: the child is easy sick in winter
entries.natural: the child gets sick easily in winter
entries.sourcePattern: dễ bệnh -> easy sick; English uses gets sick easily
entries.context: My sister worries because the child is easy sick in winter.

entries.vietlish: she is hard to eat vegetables
entries.natural: she has trouble eating vegetables
entries.sourcePattern: khó ăn rau -> hard to eat; English uses has trouble + gerund
entries.context: Since childhood, she is hard to eat vegetables.

entries.vietlish: this document is missing one signature
entries.natural: this document is missing a signature
entries.sourcePattern: thiếu một chữ ký -> missing one; English needs article before singular count noun
entries.context: The clerk said this document is missing one signature.

entries.vietlish: the street is having traffic jam
entries.natural: there is a traffic jam on the street
entries.sourcePattern: đường bị kẹt xe -> street is having; English uses there is
entries.context: At five o’clock, the street is having traffic jam.

entries.vietlish: my family has five mouths to feed
entries.natural: I have five family members to support
entries.sourcePattern: năm miệng ăn -> mouths to feed can be idiomatic, but context needs family members to support
entries.context: My family has five mouths to feed, so I must save money.

entries.vietlish: I am going the outside for air
entries.natural: I am going outside for some air
entries.sourcePattern: ra ngoài -> the outside; English adverb outside needs no the
entries.context: The office is stuffy, so I am going the outside for air.

entries.vietlish: the baby is sleeping deliciously
entries.natural: the baby is sleeping soundly
entries.sourcePattern: ngủ ngon -> sleep deliciously; English uses sleep soundly/well
entries.context: Please speak quietly because the baby is sleeping deliciously.

entries.vietlish: I do not know this word means what
entries.natural: I do not know what this word means
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese indirect questions keep statement-plus-question-word order; English embeds what before subject
entries.context: Can you explain it? I do not know this word means what.

entries.vietlish: please tell me the meeting starts when
entries.natural: please tell me when the meeting starts
entries.sourcePattern: khi nào at clause end transfers into embedded question; English moves when forward
entries.context: I lost the email, so please tell me the meeting starts when.

entries.vietlish: I wonder this form should submit where
entries.natural: I wonder where I should submit this form
entries.sourcePattern: ở đâu at the end transfers into embedded question; English uses where + subject
entries.context: Before leaving, I wonder this form should submit where.

entries.vietlish: do you know the bus goes to airport or not
entries.natural: do you know whether the bus goes to the airport
entries.sourcePattern: có...không maps to or not; English embedded yes/no often uses whether/if
entries.context: Do you know the bus goes to airport or not?

entries.vietlish: I am not sure he paid already or not
entries.natural: I am not sure whether he has paid already
entries.sourcePattern: đã...chưa/có...không -> already or not; English uses whether/if plus perfect
entries.context: Before we send the order, I am not sure he paid already or not.

entries.vietlish: the apartment near my office small but clean
entries.natural: the apartment near my office is small but clean
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese adjectival predicates need no be; English requires be
entries.context: The apartment near my office small but clean.

entries.vietlish: my younger sister very good at math
entries.natural: my younger sister is very good at math
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese adjective predicate drops be; English requires is
entries.context: My younger sister very good at math, so she helps me.

entries.vietlish: the food in this café not expensive
entries.natural: the food in this café is not expensive
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese negative adjective without be transfers; English needs is not
entries.context: Many students come because the food in this café not expensive.

entries.vietlish: my room has not enough light
entries.natural: my room does not have enough light
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese có/không có maps directly; English uses do-support for have possession
entries.context: I cannot study well because my room has not enough light.

entries.vietlish: the lesson today have many new words
entries.natural: the lesson today has many new words
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese verbs do not inflect; English third-person singular needs has
entries.context: The lesson today have many new words, so I feel tired.

entries.vietlish: yesterday I go to the bank with my mother
entries.natural: yesterday I went to the bank with my mother
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese tense is contextual; English marks past on the verb
entries.context: Yesterday I go to the bank with my mother to open an account.

entries.vietlish: last year she move to Canada
entries.natural: last year she moved to Canada
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese relies on time adverbials; English past tense still required
entries.context: Last year she move to Canada for college.

entries.vietlish: when I was child I usually walk to school
entries.natural: when I was a child, I usually walked to school
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese omits articles and past marking; English needs a child and walked
entries.context: When I was child I usually walk to school with my cousin.

entries.vietlish: I have bought this laptop since two years
entries.natural: I have had this laptop for two years
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese từ/hơn duration maps badly to since; English uses have had + for duration
entries.context: I have bought this laptop since two years and it still works well.

entries.vietlish: I stay in this neighborhood since 2021
entries.natural: I have lived in this neighborhood since 2021
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese present verb with since; English uses present perfect for residence duration
entries.context: I stay in this neighborhood since 2021, so I know the shops well.

entries.vietlish: I am working in this company five years
entries.natural: I have worked at this company for five years
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese duration without for/since; English uses present perfect + for
entries.context: I am working in this company five years and want a promotion.

entries.vietlish: I and my friend went to the market
entries.natural: my friend and I went to the market
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese permits I-first coordination; English convention puts I last
entries.context: I and my friend went to the market after class.

entries.vietlish: me and my sister cook dinner together
entries.natural: my sister and I cook dinner together
entries.sourcePattern: spoken transfer uses object pronoun subject; standard English uses subject pronoun and I-last order
entries.context: Every Sunday, me and my sister cook dinner together.

entries.vietlish: because the rain, we stayed home
entries.natural: because of the rain, we stayed home
entries.sourcePattern: vì mưa -> because the rain; English needs because of before noun phrase
entries.context: Because the rain, we stayed home and watched a movie.

entries.vietlish: although it rained but we still went out
entries.natural: although it rained, we still went out
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese paired connector mặc dù...nhưng transfers; English does not pair although with but
entries.context: Although it rained but we still went out for dinner.

entries.vietlish: if you have time please to call me
entries.natural: if you have time, please call me
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese xin/vui lòng + verb maps to please to; English uses please + base verb
entries.context: If you have time please to call me before the meeting.

entries.vietlish: I want that you help me with this form
entries.natural: I want you to help me with this form
entries.sourcePattern: muốn bạn giúp -> want that clause; English uses want + object + infinitive
entries.context: I want that you help me with this form because it is confusing.

entries.vietlish: my mother does not let me to go out late
entries.natural: my mother does not let me go out late
entries.sourcePattern: cho phép/để -> let + to transfer; English let takes bare infinitive
entries.context: My mother does not let me to go out late on weekdays.

entries.vietlish: the teacher made us to rewrite the essay
entries.natural: the teacher made us rewrite the essay
entries.sourcePattern: bắt/làm cho -> make + to transfer; English causative make takes bare infinitive
entries.context: The teacher made us to rewrite the essay after class.

entries.vietlish: I suggested him to check the price again
entries.natural: I suggested that he check the price again
entries.sourcePattern: đề nghị ai làm -> suggest someone to; English uses suggest that + clause
entries.context: Before buying the ticket, I suggested him to check the price again.

entries.vietlish: she explained me how to use the app
entries.natural: she explained to me how to use the app
entries.sourcePattern: giải thích cho tôi -> explain me; English requires explain to someone
entries.context: The clerk was patient and she explained me how to use the app.

entries.vietlish: please discuss about this problem tomorrow
entries.natural: please discuss this problem tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: thảo luận về -> discuss about; English discuss is transitive
entries.context: Please discuss about this problem tomorrow with the whole team.

entries.vietlish: we considered about moving to a cheaper room
entries.natural: we considered moving to a cheaper room
entries.sourcePattern: cân nhắc về -> consider about; English consider takes object/gerund directly
entries.context: Because rent increased, we considered about moving to a cheaper room.

entries.vietlish: she entered to the room quietly
entries.natural: she entered the room quietly
entries.sourcePattern: vào phòng -> enter to; English enter is transitive
entries.context: During the exam, she entered to the room quietly.

entries.vietlish: I reached to the airport at noon
entries.natural: I reached the airport at noon
entries.sourcePattern: đến sân bay -> reach to; English reach is transitive
entries.context: After a long ride, I reached to the airport at noon.

entries.vietlish: the house which I bought it is small
entries.natural: the house which I bought is small
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese resumptive pronoun transfers into relative clause; English drops it
entries.context: The house which I bought it is small but comfortable.

entries.vietlish: the woman who I met her yesterday is my aunt
entries.natural: the woman whom I met yesterday is my aunt
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese relative clause keeps object pronoun; English does not repeat her
entries.context: The woman who I met her yesterday is my aunt from Đà Nẵng.

entries.vietlish: this is the first time I eat sushi
entries.natural: this is the first time I have eaten sushi
entries.sourcePattern: lần đầu + present/past transfer; English first-time frame uses present perfect
entries.context: This is the first time I eat sushi, so I am nervous.

entries.vietlish: the more I study, I more understand
entries.natural: the more I study, the more I understand
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese càng...càng needs English paired the more...the more
entries.context: The more I study, I more understand why grammar matters.

entries.vietlish: not only he was late but also he forgot the file
entries.natural: not only was he late, but he also forgot the file
entries.sourcePattern: not only fronting requires inversion in formal English
entries.context: Not only he was late but also he forgot the file.

entries.vietlish: I am sensible to seafood
entries.natural: I am sensitive to seafood
entries.sourcePattern: sensible looks like nhạy cảm but means reasonable; sensitive means affected by something
entries.context: I am sensible to seafood, so I avoid shrimp.

entries.vietlish: this is a sympathetic problem for many students
entries.natural: this is a common problem for many students
entries.sourcePattern: sympathetic is not thông cảm/common; English uses common/widespread
entries.context: The tutor said this is a sympathetic problem for many students who learn articles.

entries.vietlish: my professor is very actual in technology
entries.natural: my professor is very up to date on technology
entries.sourcePattern: actual resembles hiện tại/thực tế but not current; use up to date/current
entries.context: My professor is very actual in technology and AI tools.

entries.vietlish: I assisted the conference yesterday
entries.natural: I attended the conference yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: assist can mean help, not attend; Vietnamese dự/tham dự maps to attend
entries.context: I assisted the conference yesterday and met many teachers.

entries.vietlish: can you actualize the software now
entries.natural: can you update the software now
entries.sourcePattern: actualize means make real, not cập nhật; English uses update software
entries.context: Can you actualize the software now before the meeting?

entries.vietlish: my boss controls my report carefully
entries.natural: my boss checks my report carefully
entries.sourcePattern: control can mean manage, not kiểm tra in this context; English uses check/review
entries.context: Before sending it, my boss controls my report carefully.

entries.vietlish: I need to revise for the apartment contract
entries.natural: I need to review the apartment contract
entries.sourcePattern: revise means edit/study for exam, not simply xem lại a contract in US English
entries.context: Before signing, I need to revise for the apartment contract.

entries.vietlish: the recipe is very economic
entries.natural: the recipe is very economical
entries.sourcePattern: economic relates to the economy; economical means saving money
entries.context: My aunt thinks the recipe is very economic because it uses cheap ingredients.

entries.vietlish: he is an experimented engineer
entries.natural: he is an experienced engineer
entries.sourcePattern: experimented is not experienced; Vietnamese có kinh nghiệm maps to experienced
entries.context: Our company trusts him because he is an experimented engineer.

entries.vietlish: I have many experiences in sales
entries.natural: I have a lot of experience in sales
entries.sourcePattern: experience is usually uncountable for work background
entries.context: I have many experiences in sales, so I applied for the job.

entries.vietlish: this information is very useful for my career orientation
entries.natural: this information is very useful for my career planning
entries.sourcePattern: orientation can mean introduction/direction, but định hướng nghề nghiệp is career planning/guidance
entries.context: This information is very useful for my career orientation.

entries.vietlish: my parents have a liberal thinking about my major
entries.natural: my parents are open-minded about my major
entries.sourcePattern: liberal political/philosophical sense differs from thoáng; use open-minded
entries.context: My parents have a liberal thinking about my major.

entries.vietlish: the teacher gave us a control test
entries.natural: the teacher gave us a quiz
entries.sourcePattern: control test from kiểm tra/control languages; English uses quiz/test
entries.context: At the end of class, the teacher gave us a control test.

entries.vietlish: I will pass an interview next Monday
entries.natural: I will have an interview next Monday
entries.sourcePattern: pass an interview means succeed, not attend/have one
entries.context: I will pass an interview next Monday for a marketing job.

entries.vietlish: she learned in a famous university
entries.natural: she studied at a famous university
entries.sourcePattern: learn and study differ; Vietnamese học ở maps to study at
entries.context: She learned in a famous university before working here.

entries.vietlish: my current is too weak for this phone
entries.natural: my charger is too weak for this phone
entries.sourcePattern: current/dòng điện false friend in charger context; English names the device or output
entries.context: My current is too weak for this phone, so it charges slowly.

entries.vietlish: the shop has many promotions attractive
entries.natural: the shop has many attractive promotions
entries.sourcePattern: promotion can work, but adjective placement follows noun-adjective transfer from Vietnamese
entries.context: The shop has many promotions attractive this weekend.

entries.vietlish: I bought a fabric to clean my glasses
entries.natural: I bought a cloth to clean my glasses
entries.sourcePattern: fabric is material generally; cloth is a piece used for cleaning
entries.context: I bought a fabric to clean my glasses at the pharmacy.

entries.vietlish: this plate is made from ceramic very nice
entries.natural: this dish is made of very nice ceramic
entries.sourcePattern: plate/dish and ceramic phrasing transfer; English says made of ceramic
entries.context: This plate is made from ceramic very nice.

entries.vietlish: the hotel has a very modern equipment
entries.natural: the hotel has very modern equipment
entries.sourcePattern: equipment is uncountable; Vietnamese thiết bị count transfer
entries.context: The hotel has a very modern equipment in the gym.

entries.vietlish: I need an advice about taxes
entries.natural: I need advice about taxes
entries.sourcePattern: advice is uncountable; Vietnamese lời khuyên count transfer
entries.context: Before filing, I need an advice about taxes.

entries.vietlish: the officer printed many informations for me
entries.natural: the officer printed a lot of information for me
entries.sourcePattern: information is uncountable; Vietnamese thông tin plural transfer
entries.context: At the visa counter, the officer printed many informations for me.

entries.vietlish: this furniture are expensive
entries.natural: this furniture is expensive
entries.sourcePattern: furniture is uncountable/singular agreement; Vietnamese đồ đạc plural transfer
entries.context: This furniture are expensive but very comfortable.

entries.vietlish: my luggage are still at the airport
entries.natural: my luggage is still at the airport
entries.sourcePattern: luggage is uncountable; Vietnamese hành lý count/plural transfer
entries.context: My luggage are still at the airport after the flight.

entries.vietlish: I have a good news for you
entries.natural: I have good news for you
entries.sourcePattern: news is uncountable; Vietnamese tin vui count transfer
entries.context: I have a good news for you about the scholarship.

entries.vietlish: the police is checking the street
entries.natural: the police are checking the street
entries.sourcePattern: police takes plural agreement in standard English for the force/group
entries.context: The police is checking the street after the accident.

entries.vietlish: the staff is very friendly in this store
entries.natural: the staff are very friendly in this store
entries.sourcePattern: staff often takes plural agreement when referring to employees as people
entries.context: The staff is very friendly in this store, so I come back often.

entries.vietlish: I am boring in this meeting
entries.natural: I am bored in this meeting
entries.sourcePattern: boring describes the cause; bored describes the feeling
entries.context: I am boring in this meeting because it is too long.

entries.vietlish: the movie made me very exciting
entries.natural: the movie made me very excited
entries.sourcePattern: exciting describes cause; excited describes feeling
entries.context: The movie made me very exciting, so I watched it twice.

entries.vietlish: she felt confusing after the explanation
entries.natural: she felt confused after the explanation
entries.sourcePattern: confusing describes cause; confused describes feeling
entries.context: She felt confusing after the explanation about the bill.

entries.vietlish: I was satisfying with the service
entries.natural: I was satisfied with the service
entries.sourcePattern: satisfying describes cause; satisfied describes feeling
entries.context: I was satisfying with the service at the clinic.

entries.vietlish: the trip was very tired for my parents
entries.natural: the trip was very tiring for my parents
entries.sourcePattern: tired describes people; tiring describes the experience
entries.context: The trip was very tired for my parents because it lasted ten hours.

entries.vietlish: this machine is damage already
entries.natural: this machine is damaged already
entries.sourcePattern: damage noun/verb confused with adjective damaged
entries.context: Please do not use it because this machine is damage already.

entries.vietlish: I feel stress before the interview
entries.natural: I feel stressed before the interview
entries.sourcePattern: stress noun/verb vs adjective stressed
entries.context: I feel stress before the interview even though I prepared.

entries.vietlish: the lesson is too theory for beginners
entries.natural: the lesson is too theoretical for beginners
entries.sourcePattern: theory noun used as adjective; English uses theoretical
entries.context: Many students complain that the lesson is too theory for beginners.

entries.vietlish: I go eat wedding on Sunday
entries.natural: I am going to a wedding banquet on Sunday
entries.sourcePattern: đi ăn cưới literally go eat wedding; English uses go to a wedding/banquet
entries.context: I cannot join the trip because I go eat wedding on Sunday.

entries.vietlish: she went to eat death anniversary at her uncle house
entries.natural: she went to a death anniversary meal at her uncle’s house
entries.sourcePattern: đi ăn giỗ literal transfer; English needs cultural paraphrase
entries.context: She went to eat death anniversary at her uncle house yesterday.

entries.vietlish: my family makes anniversary for my grandfather
entries.natural: my family holds a death anniversary ceremony for my grandfather
entries.sourcePattern: làm giỗ -> make anniversary; English needs hold ceremony/meal
entries.context: Every year my family makes anniversary for my grandfather.

entries.vietlish: we drink wedding wine with the groom
entries.natural: we toasted the groom at the wedding
entries.sourcePattern: uống rượu cưới/chúc rượu -> drink wedding wine; English uses toast
entries.context: At the party, we drink wedding wine with the groom.

entries.vietlish: my mother goes market every morning
entries.natural: my mother goes to the market every morning
entries.sourcePattern: đi chợ omits preposition/article; English needs to the market
entries.context: My mother goes market every morning to buy fresh vegetables.

entries.vietlish: I buy things in the wet market
entries.natural: I shop at the wet market
entries.sourcePattern: mua đồ ở chợ -> buy things; English uses shop at in routine context
entries.context: On weekends, I buy things in the wet market near my house.

entries.vietlish: the shop sells same same products
entries.natural: the shop sells very similar products
entries.sourcePattern: giống giống -> same same; English uses very similar
entries.context: I compared two stores and found that the shop sells same same products.

entries.vietlish: this shirt wears very cool
entries.natural: this shirt feels very cool
entries.sourcePattern: mặc mát -> wears cool; English uses feels cool/is cool to wear
entries.context: In summer, this shirt wears very cool.

entries.vietlish: these shoes go very painful
entries.natural: these shoes are painful to walk in
entries.sourcePattern: đi đau chân -> shoes go painful; English reframes walk in shoes
entries.context: These shoes go very painful after ten minutes.

entries.vietlish: I cut hair already yesterday
entries.natural: I got my hair cut yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: cắt tóc rồi -> cut hair already; English causative get hair cut
entries.context: I cut hair already yesterday, so it looks shorter.

entries.vietlish: my house is far school three kilometers
entries.natural: my house is three kilometers from school
entries.sourcePattern: nhà xa trường ba cây số -> far school distance; English uses from and measurement phrase
entries.context: My house is far school three kilometers, so I ride a bike.

entries.vietlish: the company is near my house ten minutes
entries.natural: the company is ten minutes from my house
entries.sourcePattern: gần nhà mười phút -> near house ten minutes; English uses from with travel time
entries.context: The company is near my house ten minutes by bus.

entries.vietlish: I am in grade twelve this year
entries.natural: I am in twelfth grade this year
entries.sourcePattern: lớp 12 -> grade twelve; US English normally twelfth grade
entries.context: I am in grade twelve this year and preparing for university.

entries.vietlish: my child learns class one
entries.natural: my child is in first grade
entries.sourcePattern: học lớp một -> learns class one; English uses be in first grade
entries.context: My child learns class one at the local primary school.

entries.vietlish: the school lets students off at eleven
entries.natural: school lets out at eleven
entries.sourcePattern: tan học -> lets students off; English phrasal verb school lets out
entries.context: On Fridays, the school lets students off at eleven.

entries.vietlish: I sleep noon after lunch
entries.natural: I take a nap after lunch
entries.sourcePattern: ngủ trưa -> sleep noon; English uses take a nap
entries.context: When I work from home, I sleep noon after lunch.

entries.vietlish: my father drinks morning coffee every day
entries.natural: my father has coffee every morning
entries.sourcePattern: uống cà phê sáng -> drink morning coffee; English routine uses have coffee every morning
entries.context: My father drinks morning coffee every day before reading news.

entries.vietlish: she eats vegetarian on the first lunar day
entries.natural: she eats vegetarian food on the first lunar day
entries.sourcePattern: ăn chay -> eat vegetarian; English needs vegetarian food or is vegetarian
entries.context: My aunt told me that she eats vegetarian on the first lunar day of each month.

entries.vietlish: we go pagoda during Lunar New Year
entries.natural: we go to the pagoda during Lunar New Year
entries.sourcePattern: đi chùa -> go pagoda; English needs go to the pagoda
entries.context: In my family, we go pagoda during Lunar New Year.

entries.vietlish: I burn incense for my grandparents altar
entries.natural: I light incense at my grandparents’ altar
entries.sourcePattern: thắp nhang -> burn incense; English often uses light incense at altar
entries.context: On important days, I burn incense for my grandparents altar.

entries.vietlish: the house has ancestor table in the living room
entries.natural: the house has an ancestral altar in the living room
entries.sourcePattern: bàn thờ gia tiên literal ancestor table; English uses ancestral altar
entries.context: The house has ancestor table in the living room.

entries.vietlish: please wear helmet carefully
entries.natural: please wear your helmet properly
entries.sourcePattern: đội mũ cẩn thận -> wear carefully; English uses properly/securely
entries.context: Before riding, please wear helmet carefully.

entries.vietlish: the police caught alcohol drivers last night
entries.natural: the police stopped drunk drivers last night
entries.sourcePattern: bắt tài xế có cồn -> caught alcohol drivers; English uses stopped/arrested drunk drivers
entries.context: The police caught alcohol drivers last night near the bridge.

entries.vietlish: he was blown alcohol by traffic police
entries.natural: he took a breathalyzer test from traffic police
entries.sourcePattern: thổi nồng độ cồn -> blown alcohol; English uses breathalyzer test
entries.context: After the party, he was blown alcohol by traffic police.

entries.vietlish: I lost vehicle papers on the bus
entries.natural: I lost my vehicle registration papers on the bus
entries.sourcePattern: giấy tờ xe -> vehicle papers; English specifies registration/ownership papers
entries.context: I lost vehicle papers on the bus and felt worried.

entries.vietlish: the landlord takes house money on the fifth
entries.natural: the landlord collects rent on the fifth
entries.sourcePattern: tiền nhà -> house money; English uses rent
entries.context: The landlord takes house money on the fifth every month.

entries.vietlish: we share room money with two friends
entries.natural: we split the rent with two friends
entries.sourcePattern: chia tiền phòng -> share room money; English uses split the rent
entries.context: To save costs, we share room money with two friends.

entries.vietlish: the water money increased this month
entries.natural: the water bill increased this month
entries.sourcePattern: tiền nước -> water money; English uses water bill
entries.context: The water money increased this month because of a leak.

entries.vietlish: my mother keeps lucky money for me
entries.natural: my mother keeps my Lunar New Year lucky money for me
entries.sourcePattern: tiền lì xì -> lucky money needs cultural frame in English
entries.context: When I was small, my mother keeps lucky money for me.

entries.vietlish: children ask age from older people on New Year
entries.natural: children ask older people’s age during New Year
entries.sourcePattern: hỏi tuổi -> ask age; English needs possessive/object phrasing and cultural context
entries.context: In my hometown, children ask age from older people on New Year.

entries.vietlish: we invite tea to guests first
entries.natural: we offer tea to guests first
entries.sourcePattern: mời trà -> invite tea; English uses offer tea
entries.context: When guests arrive, we invite tea to guests first.

entries.vietlish: the host invited me eat more rice
entries.natural: the host urged me to eat more
entries.sourcePattern: mời ăn thêm cơm -> invite eat more rice; English uses urge/offer more food
entries.context: At dinner, the host invited me eat more rice many times.

entries.vietlish: I send you a little gift for taking luck
entries.natural: I am sending you a small gift for good luck
entries.sourcePattern: lấy may -> taking luck; English says for good luck
entries.context: Before your exam, I send you a little gift for taking luck.

entries.vietlish: my parents see good day for moving house
entries.natural: my parents choose an auspicious day to move house
entries.sourcePattern: xem ngày tốt -> see good day; English uses choose/check auspicious day
entries.context: My parents see good day for moving house next month.

entries.vietlish: we must worship kitchen gods before New Year
entries.natural: we make offerings to the Kitchen Gods before Lunar New Year
entries.sourcePattern: cúng ông Công ông Táo -> worship kitchen gods; English cultural paraphrase uses make offerings
entries.context: In my family, we must worship kitchen gods before New Year.

entries.vietlish: Hey teacher, check my essay now
entries.natural: Could you please check my essay when you have a chance?
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese role terms plus direct imperative can transfer into overly blunt English teacher requests
entries.context: Hey teacher, check my essay now because I need to submit it.

entries.vietlish: Dear boss, I want to quit tomorrow
entries.natural: Dear Ms. Nguyen, I would like to resign effective tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese direct muốn nghỉ lacks formal resignation frame in English
entries.context: Dear boss, I want to quit tomorrow because I found another job.

entries.vietlish: Give me your passport
entries.natural: May I see your passport, please?
entries.sourcePattern: Service-counter English softens document requests; literal imperative sounds rude
entries.context: At the hotel desk, the clerk said, Give me your passport.

entries.vietlish: You sit and wait here
entries.natural: Please have a seat and wait here
entries.sourcePattern: Direct Vietnamese imperative transfer needs please/softener in service English
entries.context: At the clinic, the receptionist told me, You sit and wait here.

entries.vietlish: You have to send me the file before lunch
entries.natural: Could you send me the file before lunch?
entries.sourcePattern: phải gửi may be direct; workplace English often uses could/request framing
entries.context: In the email, my coworker wrote, You have to send me the file before lunch.

entries.vietlish: I need you to explain again immediately
entries.natural: Could you explain that again?
entries.sourcePattern: Direct urgency can sound demanding; English request needs modal softening
entries.context: During class I said, I need you to explain again immediately.

entries.vietlish: Why you do like that
entries.natural: Could you help me understand why you did it that way?
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese why-question can sound accusatory; English workplace feedback softens intent
entries.context: In the team chat, he wrote, Why you do like that.

entries.vietlish: Your work is wrong
entries.natural: There may be an issue with this part of your work
entries.sourcePattern: Blunt correction lacks English face-saving hedge in professional contexts
entries.context: The manager commented, Your work is wrong, on the draft.

entries.vietlish: I cannot help you
entries.natural: I’m sorry, but I’m not able to help with that
entries.sourcePattern: Direct refusal is grammatically possible but too abrupt for service/register target
entries.context: When the customer asked, the agent replied, I cannot help you.

entries.vietlish: No, I do not agree
entries.natural: I see it differently
entries.sourcePattern: Direct disagreement may need softer professional phrasing in English
entries.context: In the meeting, I said, No, I do not agree with your plan.

entries.vietlish: You are misunderstanding me
entries.natural: I may not have explained that clearly
entries.sourcePattern: English often softens blame by owning clarity rather than accusing listener
entries.context: When my client looked confused, I said, You are misunderstanding me.

entries.vietlish: Please kindly help me to check soonest
entries.natural: Could you please check this as soon as you can?
entries.sourcePattern: Overformal stacked politeness from Vietnamese business English; English prefers one clear softener
entries.context: In my email, I wrote, Please kindly help me to check soonest.

entries.vietlish: I would like to ask for your precious help
entries.natural: Could I ask for your help?
entries.sourcePattern: Over-ceremonial kính nhờ style transfers into unnatural English
entries.context: To my classmate, I wrote, I would like to ask for your precious help.

entries.vietlish: Respected teacher, I have a question
entries.natural: Hi Professor Nguyen, I have a question
entries.sourcePattern: Overliteral kính thưa/respected title can sound archaic in English email
entries.context: At the start of the email, I wrote, Respected teacher, I have a question.

entries.vietlish: Thanks you for listening me
entries.natural: Thank you for listening to me
entries.sourcePattern: Formulaic thanks plus pronoun/preposition transfer; English uses thank you and listen to
entries.context: At the end of my speech, I said, Thanks you for listening me.

entries.vietlish: Sorry for making you uncomfortable feeling
entries.natural: I’m sorry I made you uncomfortable
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese nouny apology frame transfers; English uses concise clause
entries.context: After the joke, I said, Sorry for making you uncomfortable feeling.

entries.vietlish: I request you approve my leave
entries.natural: Could you approve my leave request?
entries.sourcePattern: Formal request verb used too directly; English workplace asks with modal
entries.context: In the message to HR, I wrote, I request you approve my leave.

entries.vietlish: Please response me soon
entries.natural: Please respond soon
entries.sourcePattern: response/respond confusion plus direct object transfer; English uses respond to me/reply soon
entries.context: At the end of the email, she wrote, Please response me soon.

entries.vietlish: Noted with thanks and best regards to you
entries.natural: Noted, thanks
entries.sourcePattern: Overextended business-email formula sounds unnatural for simple acknowledgement
entries.context: In the chat, I replied, Noted with thanks and best regards to you.

entries.vietlish: I hope you sympathize for me
entries.natural: I hope you understand
entries.sourcePattern: Vietnamese mong thông cảm maps to sympathize; English service apology uses understand
entries.context: Because I was late, I wrote, I hope you sympathize for me.
